subject: Restore Bow action at active-shot equip START
description: A non-script PC bow equip owned by the specialized active-shot runner bypassed Human::Execute's synchronous MSG_SELECT_ACTION(BOW), leaving the portrait action and selection side effects stale. The bow owner now publishes that callback at equip START. Messenger handling also mirrors Original's addressed non-NoAction path: a selected target in a multi-selection first collapses selection to that PC, performs single-selection restitution, then fans out the requested action, preserving another PC's retained shot. Script-driven equips remain suppressed. Focused equip, script, and multi-selection controls pass; the former frame-723/panic family clears and advances to an independent frame-948 mismatch.
